company.name: Greener Herd
company.shortDescription: Revolutionizing livestock farming with AI-driven solutions for higher yields, sustainability, and reduced emissions.
company.description: Greener Herd is pioneering the future of livestock farming with cutting-edge AI solutions designed to reduce methane emissions, enhance productivity, and promote sustainability. Our app empowers producers with real-time data and actionable insights, helping them optimize animal health, maximize yields, and contribute to global food security. Focused on reducing environmental impact, Greener Herd connects farmers with the tools, resources, and funding they need to grow their operations responsibly. Our mission is to lead a global shift towards more sustainable, efficient, and profitable livestock production.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,274,324 to $8,364,108, a 2.55x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 77 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 45 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include AgriWebb, Herdwatch Limited, Farmbrite.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
